_doc: Content names the oracle set itself spells where the game stores only the joaat hash and no in-scope game file carries the text (entitySet names, cutscene object names - the strings live in scripts or the reference exporter's own index, both outside our read set). Loaded additively by _names_from_view: setdefault never displaces a real filename hash, and a name only ever fires where joaat(name) equals the stored hash, so a wrong entry cannot mis-name anything. Each entry cites its witnessing oracle. Maintainer decision 2026-08-08 (Matt declined the ruling as not-his-concern; function over spelling purity). Reversible: delete this file and the corpus reverts to hash_XXXXXXXX spellings on the next regeneration.
